headline: Reddit’s AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio/video content. AI voices read posts and comments, transforming written discussions. This initiative aims to offer new ways for users to consume Reddit content.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show. The show focuses on trending social media topics and web searches. 'Searched' airs on ABC News Live, available on Disney Plus and other platforms.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99 at Woot. This 65-percent keyboard is an affordable entry into the custom keyboard hobby. Use coupon WOOTGAMING for the discount; first-time Woot customers get an additional perk.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game, Dartwords, blends elements of Wordle with a Clippy-like assistant. Created by game designer Sam Rosenthal, known for Blaseball. It offers a fresh take on daily word puzzles with an interactive twist.

headline: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p portable USB monitor is currently on sale. It serves as an excellent secondary screen for laptops. Also ideal for expanding the display of devices like Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: James Gunn Defends DCU's Tonal Shift Amid 'Lanterns' Controversy
summary: James Gunn defended the DCU's varying tones following criticism of 'Lanterns'. He clarified that the DCU will not adhere to a single, uniform tone. The defense comes after the gritty first episode of 'Lanterns' sparked debate.

headline: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Features House of the Dragon Designs
summary: Amazon is hosting a sale on Game of Thrones themed T-shirts. The sale includes popular designs inspired by House of the Dragon. Fans can find various apparel from the popular fantasy series.

headline: 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198 on Amazon
summary: The 65-inch Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is now priced at $1,198 on Amazon. This model was rated as the best gaming TV in 2026. The deal includes free shipping for the high-performance television.

headline: Trump Threatens Oman Over Iran Deal Intervention
summary: Donald Trump reportedly threatened to bomb US ally Oman. The threat stems from Oman's involvement in Iran deal negotiations. Oman had been holding separate talks with Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Russia Warns UK Over Ukraine Drone Supply
summary: Russia issued a warning to the UK regarding its supply of drones to Ukraine. The UK Ministry of Defence reiterated its 'shoulder to shoulder' support for Ukraine. The warning highlights escalating tensions between Russia and NATO allies.

headline: FIFA Official Sacked After Criticizing President Infantino
summary: Senior FIFA figure Kevin Lamour was sacked by the governing body. His dismissal followed criticism of FIFA President Gianni Infantino's plans. Lamour's termination occurred three weeks after his public comments.

headline: Tributes for Actress Hayden Panettiere; No Signs of Trauma Found
summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at age 36. Tributes are pouring in for the star of 'Heroes' and 'Nashville.' The coroner found no signs of trauma, ruling out foul play.
